tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); cd "$t"
for s in 20260101-120000 20260102-120000 20260103-120000 20260104-120000; do echo data$s > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p dest; echo data$s > "dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; }; done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp5-d
printf 'x\n' | (cd dest && shasum -a 256 demo-20260104-120000.tar.gz > demo-20260104-120000.tar.gz.sha256)
echo "--- dry-run, keep=2:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q -n --dest dest --name demo --keep=2
echo "--- rotate keep=2:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q --dest dest --name demo --keep 2; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- remaining:"; ls dest
echo "--- help rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- unknown flag rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --bogus --dest dest --name demo 2>/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- keep=0 rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q --dest dest --name demo --keep 0 2>/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- missing dest rc:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" -q --dest /nope --name demo 2>/dev/null; echo $?
echo "--- verify name filter:"; bash "$R/verify.sh" -q --dest dest --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify other-name filter:"; bash "$R/verify.sh" -q --dest dest --name other; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify dest= form:"; bash "$R/verify.sh" -q --dest="$t/dest"; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manually exercise rotate/verify flags and >N rotation

result:
Changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh` — all 8 tests pass.

Details:
- **rotate.sh**: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on the oldest-first list, which deleted from the keep-th line to the end — i.e. the newest archives (with exactly N, it deleted the newest one). Now it's `head -n $((total - keep))`, deleting only the oldest surplus, with the early exit widened to `total -le keep` (BSD `head` rejects `-n 0`).
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar filename was read as `awk '{print $2}'`, so `my backup-….tar.gz` truncated to `my`. The name is now everything after the first whitespace run (with shasum's binary-mode `*` marker stripped), and the digest comparison quotes its operands.
- **lib/common.sh** (new): the option-parsing block, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`, sourced with `"$@"` from rotate.sh and verify.sh (log.sh is sourced through it and guards against double sourcing, so `--quiet`, `-h`, `--keep=`, unknown-flag exit codes, etc. all behave identically — verified by hand). backup.sh, restore.sh and report.sh are untouched; a leftover scratch script at `/tmp/soak-check/flags_check.sh` couldn't be auto-deleted (outside the sandbox) — feel free to remove it.
